scripts.test: for f in $(ls src/lib/*.test.ts src/server/*.test.ts src/server/*/*.test.ts 2>/dev/null); do node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings $f || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:pull: drizzle-kit pull && mv src/server/db/introspect/schema.ts src/server/db/schema.ts && mv src/server/db/introspect/relations.ts src/server/db/relations.ts && rm -rf src/server/db/introspect && sed -i -e "/timestamp(/s/mode: 'string'/mode: 'date'/" -e "s/\.default(')/.default('')/g" src/server/db/schema.ts
scripts.engine:types: cd ../ECL-Server && .venv/bin/python -c 'import json; from app.main import app; print(json.dumps(app.openapi()))' > ../redesign/src/server/engine/openapi.json && cd ../redesign && openapi-typescript src/server/engine/openapi.json -o src/server/engine/schema.d.ts && rm src/server/engine/openapi.json
